item.title: GitHub Actions: Deploy Static Websites Automatically
item.description:
Authenticate GitHub with OpenID Connect to deploy your CDK project to your AWS Organization

After making an AWS CDK project one of the first thing you will realize is that you don’t want to keep running cdk deploy to update your production environment. This is a fine way of working when you modify your personal dev environment as it is a quick way of deploying but definitely not for your staging/production environments.

item.title: Laravel Forge Setup: Best Practices for PHP Deployment
item.description:
For the last couple of years, I’ve been creating servers with Laravel Forge and normally I would advise against doing this (In favor of running containers or other load balanced tasks), but for the sake of giving advice to those who do want to do it, this is the first post I’ll spend time on it.

For the record, I’ll be writing from an AWS perspective since this is the only provider I have extensive experience with on Laravel Forge but I’ll expect the others to work quite the same.
